_note: PHA-2693 N-slice replay fixture. SYNTHETIC and committed on purpose: the Magisa fixtures this issue names were removed from the repo by 2e5b3fc for privacy, so the replay needed something reproducible that ships. Twelve invented messages, no personal material. Message ids are 1-BASED because that is what extractProvenanceRanges accepts (auditorTechnicalPass.js: start >= 1), and entry content carries real `src: msgs N-M` citations in PHA-2722's single provenance format so the provenance checks score something instead of passing vacuously. `replies` is keyed by the highest message id in the slice, so a step that legitimately skips its call never desynchronises the script.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.rawText: Grondulf the landlord frowned at the ledger and mentioned the unpaid rent again.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.rawText: Grondulf the landlord kept the ledger in a locked drawer behind the taproom bar.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.rawText: Pemberly the baker kneaded dough before dawn in a warm and floury kitchen.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.rawText: Pemberly the baker carried warm bread up the hill to the garrison gate at noon.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.rawText: The garrison sergeant paid Pemberly the baker in clipped copper and said nothing.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.rawText: The Emberfall Road ran north from the garrison gate through thin and rocky country.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.rawText: Carters on the Emberfall Road spoke of a toll nobody had agreed to pay.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.rawText: Pemberly the baker began sending bread north along the Emberfall Road as well.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.rawText: A stranger in a grey coat paid for a room upstairs in old silver coin.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.rawText: The stranger in the grey coat asked about the Emberfall Road toll and paid again.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.rawText: Pemberly the baker refused to send bread north while the toll stood unexplained.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.rawText: The stranger in the grey coat left before dawn and settled the room in old silver.

2.title: Pemberly
2.content: Corrected by hand: Pemberly is the baker, and she owns the bakery outright rather than renting it from Grondulf. (src: msgs 3-5)

2.name: Grondulf
2.content: Grondulf the landlord frowned at the ledger and mentioned the unpaid rent again, and he kept that ledger in a locked drawer behind the taproom bar. (src: msgs 1-2)

5.name: Grondulf
5.content: Grondulf, who holds the ledger, is the landlord, and rent is his recurring subject of complaint. (src: msgs 1-2)

5.name: Pemberly
5.content: Pemberly the baker kneaded dough before dawn in a warm and floury kitchen, and carried warm bread up the hill to the garrison gate at noon. (src: msgs 3-5)

8.name: Pemberly
